en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a detailed model of the polar exploration ship "Fram" displayed in a glass case inside a museum. The model sailing vessel with multiple masts and sails fills most of the foreground, with reflections of windows and other ship models in the background. Text is printed along the bottom edge in Norwegian, and there is a small printer/publisher mark at the lower right.
